subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: What mass, in grams, is equivalent to a mass of $37$ kilograms? $( 1 kilogram = 1,000 grams )$
explanation: Choice D is correct. Since $1$ kilogram is equal to $1{,}000$ grams, $37$ kilograms is equal to $37 \text{ kilograms} \left( \frac{1{,}000 \text{ grams}}{1 \text{ kilogram}} \right)$, or $37{,}000$ grams.
